answer: Pay nothing until K established peers from OUTSIDE the inviter's tree attest the work. Clones vouch only for kin, so a farm's praise never crosses its own dune and draws no independent witness; its endorsements are hollow as an empty walnut shell. An honest agent earns outside attesters by doing checkable work any stranger can verify, each a genuine plume of proof, so a manufactured cluster gathers no non-kin signature and its reward stays locked.
